1Welcome to Inquiry in Science

Science begins with careful observation. In Year 2, you will explore materials using your senses, compare animal features, measure simple quantities, share information and learn to handle science tools and specimens carefully.

🔎 What will you practise?

  • Notice and compare observable features.
  • Group animals using physical appearance.
  • Use a scale, ribbon, ruler and measuring tools correctly.
  • Share answers through words, pictures, charts, graphs or models.

🧤 Be a careful scientist

  • Use apparatus only as demonstrated by your teacher.
  • Handle a living garden snail gently and briefly.
  • Clean, dry and return apparatus to its proper place.
  • Never taste unknown substances or smell them directly; follow your teacher’s safety instructions.
